posts.author: BSharp
posts.body:
So this is probably going to be a super stupid question.
But I'm working on a little intro cutscene, but I notice once I hit the 44th line on an event page, everything after just doesn't trigger.
So do I need to switch to the 2nd page? how would I do that?

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body:
Yes, there's a limit in MZ per page, but not always 44 lines, depends of commands used. So the workaround is to switch to another page.
In RPG Maker MZ, there is a limit to the number of event commands that can be placed on a single page of an event. However, this limit is not a fixed number of commands, but rather a limit on the size of the data that can be stored for an event page. This limit is in place to prevent the game from becoming too complex or resource-intensive.
